Clara: Quick sync 1 - Blueshore procurement asked for a one-page POC acceptance + runbook and a short reserved vs burst pricing delta. They want explicit pass/fail criteria for latency and throughput before legal approves.
Noah: noted. their initial ask was p95 <200ms p99 <450ms at ~150 QPS. i think we should be conservative: propose p95 <240ms and p99 <620ms for the acceptance.
Yusuf: traffic profile i'll run: 55% short text-gen (~28 tokens), 30% long text-gen (~160 tokens), 15% embeddings. i'll attach the k6 mix and sample payloads.
Clara: ops request: replicate likely client batching. set batch_size=5, enable prefix/KV caching, pre-warm the model for 5m. pin model version to rwd-instruct-2.3 for the run.
Noah: proposed runbook (draft):
 - quick smoke: 5 QPS x 3m
 - ramp: 5 -> 160 QPS over 15m
 - steady: 160 QPS x 20m (collect steady metrics)
 - short bursts: 320 QPS x 30s x 4 iterations (validate graceful fallback)
k6 command we'll use:
```
k6 run --vus 170 --duration 20m --out json=run_output.json blueshore_mix.js
```
Yusuf: metrics to capture: p50/p90/p95/p99, success_rate, tokens_per_sec, avg seq length, KV hit %, 5xx count, model_version, GPU util and mem. include a short note if we observe cold starts > 5s.
Clara: security checklist blueshore needs: IP CIDRs to allowlist, confirmation of encryption-at-rest, KMS/HSM options, and audit/log retention. they also asked for an example data purge policy.
Security: copy for acceptance sheet: "Hosted deployment: we support CMK via our KMS connector; Private deployments support customer-managed keys and HSM. Audit logs are retained for 90 days by default; extended retention is available upon request." also uploaded the SOC2 summary to /shared/pocs/blueshore/.
Noah: quick internal baseline (non-prod): p95=190ms, p99=470ms at 110 QPS with batch=5 on a single A100-equivalent. helpful to set expectations but label as staging numbers.
Clara: pricing appendix (very rough ballpark to include):
 - Reserved pool sized for sustained 160 QPS (given their token mix): ~$12k/mo
 - Add-on amortized burst capacity to handle 320 QPS peaks: +~$2.2k/mo
Note: final pricing will depend on measured avg tokens/request and embedding ratio. we'll call this an estimate.
Yusuf: acceptance criteria i'd present to buyer:
 - Sustain 160 QPS for 20 minutes with success rate >= 99.5%
 - p95 < 240ms, p99 < 620ms
 - No unexpected 5xx during steady window. Bursts validated and graceful degradation acceptable if documented.
Clara: if Blueshore signs that, we can schedule Wed/Thu next week. Security must sign off on the wording and buyer must provide IP CIDRs + signed test consent before we run.
Security: confirmed the KMS/HSM wording above. uploaded copy-paste text and SOC2 excerpt to /shared/pocs/blueshore/sec_docs.txt.
TestBot: POC assets uploaded: k6 scripts, payloads, and sample result dashboard template -> /shared/pocs/blueshore/poc_assets/ :white_check_mark:
Clara: thanks all. i'll send the one-page acceptance + pricing appendix to the buyer and request IP CIDRs. once they ack, i'll create the calendar slot and tag ops for execution. :thumbsup:
